vertebrae.utils.memory
======================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.utils.memory

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Memory estimation and admission helpers.

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: MemoryBudget

   Resolved memory budget from a `MemoryConfig`.

   .. attribute:: total_bytes

      Total system memory.

   .. attribute:: available_bytes

      Currently available system memory.

   .. attribute:: reserve_system_bytes

      Bytes reserved for system use.

   .. attribute:: max_memory_bytes

      Maximum bytes vertebrae should use for planned work.


.. py:class:: EmbeddingMemoryEstimate

   Estimated memory footprint for an embedding artifact.

   .. attribute:: n_samples

      Number of embedding rows.

   .. attribute:: embedding_dim

      Number of embedding columns.

   .. attribute:: dtype

      Embedding dtype string.

   .. attribute:: resident_bytes

      Estimated bytes to hold the embedding artifact in memory.

   .. attribute:: dense_scoring_bytes

      Estimated dense bytes required by scoring.

   .. attribute:: batch_embedding_bytes

      Estimated bytes for one embedding batch.

   .. attribute:: strategy

      Planned strategy: `"in_memory"` or `"stream_to_disk"`.


   .. py:method:: to_dict()

      Serialize the estimate for result metadata.

      :returns: JSON-compatible memory estimate.



.. py:function:: resolve_memory_budget(config)

   Resolve an effective memory budget using psutil.

   :param config: Memory configuration.

   :returns: Resolved memory budget.


.. py:function:: estimate_embedding_from_probe(probe_embeddings, n_samples, batch_size, memory_config)

   Estimate full embedding memory from a probe batch.

   :param probe_embeddings: Dense or sparse probe embedding batch.
   :param n_samples: Full dataset sample count.
   :param batch_size: Planned embedding batch size.
   :param memory_config: Memory configuration.

   :returns: Estimated embedding footprint and strategy.


.. py:function:: estimate_matrix_resident_bytes(matrix)

   Estimate memory required to hold a dense or sparse matrix.

   :param matrix: Dense or sparse matrix.

   :returns: Estimated resident bytes.


.. py:function:: estimate_metadata_resident_bytes(metadata)

   Estimate resident bytes from embedding metadata.

   :param metadata: Embedding metadata dictionary.

   :returns: Estimated bytes, or `None` if metadata is incomplete.


.. py:function:: estimate_metadata_dense_scoring_bytes(metadata)

   Estimate dense bytes needed for scoring from embedding metadata.

   :param metadata: Embedding metadata dictionary.

   :returns: Estimated dense scoring bytes, or `None` if metadata is incomplete.


.. py:function:: assert_within_memory(required_bytes, memory_config, purpose)

   Fail fast when a planned allocation exceeds the memory budget.

   :param required_bytes: Estimated required bytes.
   :param memory_config: Memory configuration.
   :param purpose: Human-readable description of the planned work.

   :returns: Resolved memory budget.

   :raises ValueError: If `required_bytes` exceeds the configured budget.


.. py:function:: largest_fitting_subsample_rate(required_bytes, memory_config)

   Estimate the largest sample fraction that fits the memory budget.

   :param required_bytes: Estimated bytes for the full sample set.
   :param memory_config: Memory configuration.

   :returns: Fraction in `(0, 1]` that should fit the configured budget.


.. py:function:: sparse_matrix_nbytes(matrix)

   Estimate resident bytes for an existing scipy sparse matrix.


.. py:function:: sparse_nbytes_from_nnz(nnz, n_rows, dtype)

   Estimate CSR sparse bytes from non-zero count and row count.


.. py:function:: estimate_sparse_bytes(n_samples, n_features, dtype, density)

   Estimate sparse matrix bytes from shape, dtype, and density.
